body:
## Summary
- make full album stages use their own YouTube cover when set, otherwise inherit the source album cover
- show the selected album cover preview from the pipeline choose-file button tooltip
- extend the full-album Cypress flow to assert inherited thumbnail upload and cover preview tooltip state

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#193

## Tests
- npm test -- --runInBand
- npm run build
- npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js (25 passing, 2 unrelated existing failures: stage navigator active state at cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js:257 and relative publish date expectation at cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js:397; the updated full-album test passes)
